name: rabbit_density_spring_min_for_territorial_breeding
confidence_reason: Read first-hand in part (abstract and discussion): the study says 4.6 per hectare in spring was the lowest density recorded and was enough to support reproduction; it did not find a minimum, so the rule that breeding stops below it is our assumption.
draft_note: The EU report reads the figure as a needed density; the primary source does not (it says it could not determine the minimum at which lynx fail).  Replaces the earlier pair with palomares2005, which is not a conflict:  both found no effect of density on reproduction in the range they saw.

name: rabbit_density_autumn_min_for_territorial_breeding
confidence_reason: Read first-hand in part:  1.0 per hectare was the lowest autumn density recorded and reproduction was not affected; it is a level that was enough, not a measured minimum.
draft_note: Unused while the density is constant within a run.  Changed from not_checked after reading palomares2001 in part.
